items.title: Public comment at Police Commissioners Advisory Committee
items.summary: Residents can speak for up to 3 minutes at the hybrid PCAC meeting on police matters, including BRIC membership, ICE in Brookline, traffic enforcement and police work-hour caps. Email ahead of the meeting to sign up.

contacts.office: Office of Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Community Relations

items.title: Review of Brookline's membership in the Boston Regional Intelligence Center
items.summary: Subcommittees report on their investigation, ordered by Town Meeting, into whether Brookline should stay in the Boston Regional Intelligence Center (BRIC). Residents can weigh in during public comment.

items.title: Warrant Article 20: resolution on increased traffic enforcement
items.summary: The committee discusses a Town Meeting resolution calling for more traffic enforcement. Residents can share views during public comment.

items.title: ICE in Brookline update
items.summary: The committee gets an update on immigration enforcement activity in Brookline.

items.title: 18-hour daily work cap for police officers
items.summary: The committee discusses limiting police officers to 18 hours of work per day.

items.title: Civilian complaint reports
items.summary: The committee reviews reports on civilian complaints about police.
items.skip_reason: Report on individual complaints; not open to public input

items.title: PCAC website changes update
items.summary: Update on proposed changes to the committee's website.
